evidence_span.text: In contrast, Msx1 is greatly downregulated in apical turns (G, K, O; red asterisks)

reviews.rationale: Tbc1d32bromi mutant cochleae show loss of the SHH-dependent apical marker Msx1, directly demonstrating SHH signaling failure in this ciliary mutant. Context is cochlear/auditory tissue, not brain endothelium, matching the declared indirect label.

evidence_span.text: hydrocephalus and excessive nasal exudates were seen in Nme7(-/-) mice

reviews.rationale: Nme7-/- mice display situs inversus, hydrocephalus and nasal exudates consistent with primary ciliary dyskinesia, matching the narrower claim about Nme7 KO phenotype in the mechanism summary. This paper does not test the Hedgehog/Smo ciliary trafficking portion of the mechanism, but that broader claim is not required for this citation.

evidence_span.text: Tbc1d32bromi mutant, generated by ENU-mutagenesis and exhibiting defective ciliary morphology such as swollen or bulbous cilia

reviews.rationale: Tbc1d32bromi mutants show defective ciliary morphology and downstream loss of SHH target gene expression, supporting the claim that Tbc1d32 is required for ciliogenesis and Hedgehog signaling. Context is cochlear tissue, an indirect match to brain endothelium as declared.

evidence_span.text: Mitochondria in CHCHD6-knockout cells showed less cristae content than control cells.

reviews.rationale: CHCHD6 knockout in HeLa cells directly reduces cristae content and the paper shows CHCHD6 physically bridges MICOS with Sam50, supporting its role in cristae organization. Context (human HeLa cells) is an indirect match to mouse brain endothelium, consistent with the declared label.

evidence_span.text: The antibodies against CMG-1 allowed us to detect primary cilia in cultured human umbilical vein endothelial cells (HUVEC) and find conditions eliciting the disassembly of these cilia.

reviews.rationale: This paper identifies CMG-1 (human ortholog of IFT74/IFT-71) as a primary-cilium IFT component in HUVEC via immunolocalization, supporting its ciliary role, but does not test a knockout demonstrating that Ift74 is essential for assembly. Context is human umbilical vein endothelial cells, a closely transferable endothelial cell-type match to brain endothelium, consistent with the declared partial label.

evidence_span.text: Our study demonstrates that IFT74 is essential for mouse sperm formation, probably through assembly of the core axoneme and fibrous sheath

reviews.rationale: Conditional Ift74 knockout in mouse germ cells causes loss of flagellar axoneme assembly and infertility, directly demonstrating an essential IFT-B role in axonemal/ciliary assembly consistent with the mechanism claim. Context is sperm flagella, an indirect match to brain endothelial primary cilia as declared.

evidence_span.text: the mitochondria of Chchd3, Chchd6, Mitofilin, and Opa1 knockouts had smaller volumes than the WT

reviews.rationale: CRISPR knockout of Chchd6 in mouse-derived myotubes causes reduced mitochondrial volume, area, and cristae number/score, directly supporting that Chchd6 loss alters mitochondrial morphology in mice/cells. Context is aged mouse skeletal/cardiac muscle myotubes, an indirect match to brain endothelium as declared.

evidence_span.text: we conclude that the IFT-B component IFT38 makes a major contribution to the IFT-B–BBSome interface via interaction through BBS1, BBS2, and BBS9 from the BBSome

reviews.rationale: Biochemical interaction assays directly show BBS9 is a core BBSome subunit that links to the IFT-B complex via IFT38, supporting the BBSome-core-subunit claim. However, the causal GPR161 export defect is demonstrated using an IFT38 mutant and prior BBS1-KO data rather than a Bbs9-specific knockout in this paper, so the ciliary-GPCR-export functional consequence is only partially supported for Bbs9 itself. Context (HEK293T/RPE1 human cell lines) is an indirect match to brain endothelium, consistent with the declared label.
